name: Takigawa Marika
source: She's a newly wed wife, however, her life is completely devoted to her work as a nurse. She lives in the apartment at the left from Hisahiro's apartment. She really likes children and wants to have some of her own, however, her husband doesn't want to have children, this has deeply strained their relationship.
